what_it_does: Kaynes Technology India Limited is a vertically integrated Electronic System Design and Manufacturing (ESDM) enterprise. It provides conceptual design, process engineering, printed circuit board assembly, semiconductor packaging, and full lifecycle support for global original equipment manufacturers.

segments.name: Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM)
segments.comment: Delivers zero-defect manufacturing solutions for high-mix, high-value, complex mechatronic assemblies and PCBA.

segments.name: Smart Metering
segments.comment: Provides residential, commercial, and grid meters with complete meter-to-cash software suites.

segments.name: Original Design Manufacturer (ODM)
segments.comment: Emerges as a key driver of margin expansion and enhanced value capture.

scale: Order book of 83,663 Mn INR as of 31 March 2026
Consolidated revenue of 36,264 Mn INR for FY 2025-26
Debt-to-equity ratio maintained at approximately 0.19 times
Market capitalization of 229,902,049,358 INR as of 31 March 2026
risks: Geopolitical uncertainty and trade volatility affecting critical component access
Cybersecurity and data breach risks impacting enterprise digital infrastructure
Supply chain disruption and margin pressure from custom order complexity
Working capital intensity and cash conversion fluctuations
geography: Operates globally with manufacturing footprints in India, North America via August Electronics in Canada, and Europe via Sensonic GmbH in Austria.
